in_hebrew.name: אַנְטוֹנִינֹו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Antonino is derived from the Hebrew name Anton, which means 'grace' or 'God's favor'. In the Hebrew script, it is written as אַנְטוֹנִינֹו (pronounced as 'Antonino' in modern Hebrew).

in_greek.name: Αντωνίνος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Antonino in Greek is derived from the Greek name Anton, which means 'man' or 'entire' and 'unchangeable'. In the Greek script, it is written as Αντωνίνος (pronounced as 'Antoninos' in modern Greek).

in_latin.name: Antoninus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Antonino in Latin is derived from the Latin name Antoninus, which means 'man' or 'entire' and 'unchangeable'. In the Latin script, it is written as Antoninus.
